candidate_construction_procedure: Take the survivor set from evidence/BROKER_NATIVE_FRONTIER_40_UNIVARIATE_STRUCTURAL_GATE_V1.json (non-economic structural gate over the open 1578-symbol frontier).
Intersect with symbols confirmed to have a qualifying breakout event rate in evidence/BROKER_NATIVE_FRONTIER_40_BREAKOUT_VOLATILITY_EVENT_AVAILABILITY_V1.json.

Retain only symbols with consistent directional signal across BOTH evidence/BROKER_NATIVE_FRONTIER_40_BREAKOUT_15M_DIRECTIONAL_FOLLOWTHROUGH_V1.json and evidence/BROKER_NATIVE_FRONTIER_40_BREAKOUT_30M_DIRECTIONAL_PERSISTENCE_V1.json (independent horizons, reduces single-horizon overfit risk).
Apply evidence/BREAKOUT_FADE_PRE_ECONOMIC_REALIZABILITY_AUDIT_V1.json to drop any symbol failing pre-economic realizability.
Intersect the remainder with data/PEPPERSTONE_CURRENT_EUR200_SYMBOL_FEASIBILITY_INDEX_V1.json to keep only EUR200-margin-feasible symbols.

Require the resulting set to span at least 3 structurally distinct clusters (e.g. FX-major, FX-cross/commodity-linked, index/metal) with a minimum of 8 total symbols, structurally justified (not outcome-driven), to avoid repeating C032's single-symbol breadth failure.
remaining_gates_before_any_economic_free: Fresh cTrader Open API confirmation of exact broker symbol names, current spread/commission, and EUR200 margin for the materialized set (feasibility index may be stale).
Exact-head CI computation on the finalized, causally clean development window.
Cost-adjusted directional persistence re-check post transaction costs.
Explicit freeze of the envelope prior to any economic outcome opening.
decision.replacement_semantics: New design, not a rerun: C032's exact symbol/outcome-exposed evidence is excluded as OUTCOME_EXPOSED; only its structural family assignment (BREAKOUT_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION) and design_class finding (BREADTH_INSUFFICIENT_FOR_SCOPE_CHARGED) are used as the reason to widen breadth, not as prospective input.
decision.serial_dependence_context: evidence/EPOCH20_SERIAL_DEPENDENCE_SCREEN_V1.json pooled negative autocorrelation (h1=-0.145, h3=-0.066, h6=-0.032, n>300k) across the same 40-series pool is treated as descriptive-only corroboration of a fade/reversion directional prior; it is explicitly not used for candidate selection, significance, or PnL claims per its own interpretation_boundary.
decision.unresolved_prerequisite_note: C006 cash-session calendar, C029 settlement coverage, and C030 zero-settled-trade prerequisites belong to distinct, already-adjudicated identities (V2-C006, V2-C029, V2-C030) and are not reopened or required by this replacement design.

next_research_state.follow_on_step: Once the exact intersected symbol list is materialized from the cited artifacts, submit a subsequent proposal requesting fresh PEPPERSTONE_ACCOUNT_VIA_CTRADER_OPEN_API data for those exact symbols to verify current cost/margin and compute exact-head CI before any freeze.

objective.goal: Materialize a breadth-adequate, non-outcome-exposed replacement scope for the BREAKOUT_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION/FADE family (successor design to the breadth-insufficient V2-C032 identity) by intersecting already-accepted, reusable structural evidence — the 40-symbol frontier univariate structural gate, breakout event availability, 15M directional follow-through, 30M directional persistence, and the pre-economic realizability audit — with the EUR200 margin feasibility index, so the next economic-eligible candidate carries enough structurally heterogeneous symbols to clear the breadth gate that C032 failed on.
objective.information_gain_rationale: C032 was rejected as BREADTH_INSUFFICIENT_FOR_SCOPE_CHARGED (1 symbol) despite a mechanism family with the richest existing non-economic evidence stack in the eligibility packet (event availability + two independent directional-persistence horizons + a pre-economic realizability audit + a fresh pooled serial-dependence screen across 40 series showing consistent negative autocorrelation at h=1,3,6). Reassembling breadth from these already-accepted artifacts, rather than proposing a new mechanism from scratch, maximizes information gain per unit of scarce economic capacity: it reuses fully-vetted structural evidence, respects the causal prohibition on rerunning C032's opened identity, and produces the smallest remaining gap (fresh cost/margin/exact-head confirmation) before an economic freeze can be legally authorized.
